structural_resolution: Different native sizes are not corruption. Retain readable same-episode filename pairs for episode-level independent modality encoders; no pixel-wise registration or timestamp synchrony is asserted.
unresolved_reason_policy: Only rgb_depth_spatial_shape_mismatch may be resolved by independent geometry-preserving letterbox preprocessing. All other integrity issues stop execution.
primary_pool: Within each episode, consolidate identical decoded RGB arrays into one visual observation. Choose the pair with the smallest numeric frame index as the deterministic representative; retain the other depth arrays in the immutable source snapshot and map them to the representative.
duplicate_sensitivity: The full 3815 filename-paired inventory remains available as a prespecified sampling sensitivity analysis, not an additional independent cohort.
rgb_resize: Aspect-ratio-preserving bilinear resize, centered zero padding to 160x160
depth_resize: Aspect-ratio-preserving nearest-neighbour resize, centered zero padding to 160x160; independent of RGB native size
depth_scale: Per-frame finite positive values: percentiles 1 and 99, clip to percentile interval, scale to [0,1], invalid pixels zero
evaluation_sampling: Equally spaced representative indices; if fewer than 12, use each once then pad with the last representative. Save valid-token mask and original unique count. Padding is not a new observation.
outer_split: Legacy animal-group three-fold membership, independently checked against every pair

inner_validation.selection: Use non-test animals only. Lexicographically minimise missing training classes, missing validation classes, then squared deviation of validation per-class episode fraction from target. Candidate ties retain first generated candidate. No images or model outcomes used.

training_augmentation: Not yet configured; no augmentation applied to this cache
reference_scale: Integer BCS 2-6 from original 1-9 scale; class index BCS-2, no relabelling
